title: title_case drops empty words handling
description: title_case should capitalize each word and lowercase the rest, but it only uppercases the first letter without lowercasing the remainder, so already-uppercase input stays wrong.

files.casing.py:
def title_case(s):
    return ' '.join(word[0].upper() + word[1:] for word in s.split())

hidden_tests.test_casing.py:
from casing import title_case


def test_title_case():
    assert title_case('hello world') == 'Hello World'
    assert title_case('HELLO WORLD') == 'Hello World'
    assert title_case('pyThon ROCKS') == 'Python Rocks'

fix:
def title_case(s):
    return ' '.join(word[0].upper() + word[1:].lower() for word in s.split())
